title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My question is as: zakat is farz on the cost of property (I mean extra house,shops,land etc)or not. And add to his misery he has one mentally retarded son of 22 years old. He is SYED therefore can we give zakat to our sister who is not SYED. Can we motivate others also to give her zakat? 1756 views Q. Can you please advise if there is an islamic establishmnet, say a madrassa where poor students are boarded and from where they get their islamic and worldly education. And since the students are poor and recipients of zakaat, the organization that runs this madrassa collects zakaat from the general public to meet the general expenses of these poor students. What are the rules on consuming this zakaat money by 1) the admininstrators and teachers of this madrassa, for their salary? 2) eating food by these teachers and staff from the same zakaat money collected for the food expenses of these poor students 3) can the same zakaat money be used to cook food for the general public if say there is a public lecture at this madrassa or at a near by mosque? 2246 views Q. Is it included in zakah with old gold and I saved some cash money as well 3 months ago will this be included as well? 6052 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 47100 Country: Pakistan Title: Zakah Question: I do not know when I became sahib-e-nisaab so when should I give zakat? I mean from which month I should give zakat? Answer ID: 47100 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1193/777/L=9/1434) You should yourself have estimation and in case of doubt you should choose what is more precautious e.g. you doubted whether you became owner of nisab in Muharram or Safar, then you should choose Muharram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
